pr_title: Fix lounge screen showing information sourced from wrong playlist item
pr_body:
Closes #16115.

Turns out it wasn't only the background, but the "currently playing item" text too sometimes. Recommended testing scenario is: creating a room with round robin, creating 2 items as player A, and then one as player B. Current master will show the second player A item rather than the player B one on backgrounds after the first player A item is played.

Fixed by implementing a new `GetCurrentItem()` extension method that is supposed to return the right map. Tests are indirect (i.e. the extension is tested rather than its consumers), I've tested that this visually looks correct manually. Will attempt to add visual test cases for this on request but it's bound to be rather finicky due to things tested being mostly visual.

Note that while the extension method has special handling for the "all items expired" case, it won't actually be visible in the lounge because of the following call:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/8acfefed1b1346430c68b14d922f27ebe0ac1ffd/osu.Game/Screens/OnlinePlay/Components/ListingPollingComponent.cs#L59-L63

I'm told that is going to be changing and web is going to be sending just the one valid playlist item eventually, at which point this problem goes away entirely client-side, so I didn't bother to fix that case (and behaviour is not changed from current `master`). But I'll revisit that on request.

issue_context.title: DrawableRoom sometimes shows wrong background on currently playing item in lobby listing
issue_context.body:
Should be simple to fix now that playlist items have orders. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/16113
Originally posted by **Theighlin** December 16, 2021 https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/53081750/146358594-aa330456-8dd6-4700-acf4-261e9c3997a7.mp4 [database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7726616/database.log) [network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7726618/network.log) [performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7726619/performance.log) [runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/7726620/runtime.log)

review_comments:
It's not a huge deal but I would also add a default case. For example, let's suppose that Playlists is updated so that upon a room expiring, all items from the room are expired too. I'd probably return `.FirstOrDefault()` to cover that scenario.

As an aside, how about writing this in a similar way to osu-server-spectator:
https://github.com/ppy/osu-server-spectator/blob/0512ffee735c7a91693ce0776ad280669fd366bb/osu.Server.Spectator/Hubs/MultiplayerQueue.cs#L240-L241
Such that there's a `GetUpcomingItems()` and `GetHistoricalItems()` (or something like that) which could also be used for `MultiplayerQueueList` and `MultiplayerHistoryList`.

I'm a little confused. Is this edge case not handled already? As in, with the code as it is, when all items are expired, the last played expired item will be returned. I'm not understanding how is that different from the scenario you mention.

`PlaylistOrder` is not valid for expired items. The `PlaylistItem` member is missing the doc but it's present on `MultiplayerPlaylistItem`:
https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/2ea31c26a58ddc1d954a02e5313057352b968186/osu.Game/Online/Rooms/MultiplayerPlaylistItem.cs#L42-L50

This is because at one point the server used to change the order for expired items too, though that doesn't _seem_ to be the case anymore. Still prefer using `PlayedAt` in case this changes in the future.
I've made some changes and introduced the two new extension methods as suggested. Let me know if they meet your expectations.
